original_test_intent: Verify the exact BMC Manager's Redfish LogServices collection is securely readable, schema-valid, complete and semantically correct for the project while protecting sensitive log metadata.
original_method: Discover the Manager resource, perform a certificate-validating read-only GET with protected credentials, validate collection resource metadata/count/member links against the approved firmware contract, bound optional member traversal and preserve redacted complete evidence.
manual_activity: The owner supplies the correct Manager/member contract and log retention/redaction policy, then confirms semantic collection correctness.
required_inputs: Exact BMC/Manager identity and discovered LogServices URI
Firmware/API/schema versions and expected collection/member ResourceTypes
Expected service count, member IDs/links and required fields
TLS CA/certificate, protected least-privilege credential and session policy
Sensitive-log redaction, size limit, traversal and retention rules
safety_requirements: Validate target and TLS; no -k, hardcoded root password or CLI/URL secrets
Use GET only and explicitly prohibit ClearLog/delete/action requests
Apply response-size, traversal and timeout bounds before following members
Redact secrets/security/fault details per policy while retaining validation hashes/structure
Stop on wrong Manager, auth/certificate failure, malformed schema, inaccessible member or unsafe-to-retain content
agent_execution_scope: Discover and verify service/Manager/LogServices identity and approved contract
GET collection using protected read-only authentication and capture status/JSON
Validate ResourceType/OData/count/member links and optionally traverse only approved metadata
Apply policy-driven redaction and report completeness/discrepancies for engineer verdict
Perform no log mutation or independent sensitive-data retention choice
engineer_actions: Provide expected Manager, LogServices/member matrix and schema/firmware baseline
Approve redaction/retention/traversal policy and least-privilege scope
Review collection completeness/correctness and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: GET plus structured JSON is directionally correct, but curl -k/CLI credentials, unresolved Manager identity and unrestricted full output are unsafe; jq formatting does not validate schema, member completeness or correctness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a certificate-validating Redfish client to discover and GET the exact Manager LogServices collection, schema-check count/links/fields and store only approved redacted evidence under bounds.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Manager LogServices collection read and 5/5-minute estimates remain; literal manager bmc and root/0penBmc are unsafe source placeholders to be discovered/replaced.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH PACKAGE-GATED REDFISH LOGSERVICE COLLECTION VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an immutable inventory of collection @odata.id/type, Members@odata.count and each member ID/type/status, cross-check count/uniqueness/reachability and store a redaction manifest plus hashes.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure discovery, completeness and privacy validation instead of insecure pretty-print output.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readable JSON proves neither the correct Manager nor complete/valid member inventory; member count, unique links, ResourceTypes and required fields need explicit checks.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Log service metadata can disclose platform/security state and may be large or OEM-specific. Correctness depends on the project firmware/member contract.

project_override_considerations: OEM services and Manager IDs may differ; the project matrix must name expected members and sensitive fields without allowing missing services to disappear from the denominator.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and BMC/Manager/firmware/API/schema/TLS identity
Redacted collection status/JSON/hash with @odata metadata and Members count
Per-member unique link/resource/status/reachability comparison to approved matrix
Redaction/retention report, no-log-mutation audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target the Manager LogServices collection. Hardcoded manager/credentials, unsafe TLS and unspecified correctness are readiness/security gaps rather than contradictory requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Manager discovery, expected member matrix and redaction policy gate execution but permit complete static review.

review_improvement: Converts an insecure pretty-print check into resource-identity, schema, completeness and privacy evidence while preserving read-only coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: Collection correctness is relational: Members@odata.count must agree with unique member links, each approved link must resolve to the expected service on the same BMC snapshot, and unexpected/missing members must be explicit. Returning unrestricted JSON can itself violate the evidence policy because log service names or OEM metadata may reveal operational details. Thus redaction needs a manifest and hashes so privacy protection does not silently remove evidence needed for completeness.
